Thirsty Turtle

Dover, NH · Road

Beginner friendly

Thirsty Turtle is a road group ride in Dover, NH. It rolls every Thursday at 6:00 pm from Dover Cyclery. Pace: 14–16 mph.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 14–16 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills.
Check
Look at @dovercyclery the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Thirsty Turtle group ride

An hour-long Thursday evening ride open to all abilities, then pizza and beer at La Festa. The shop's faster Tuesday Night Ride (19–20 mph, 30–45 miles) leaves from the same door at 5:30.
